question: What minimum iOS or Android version is required for a mobile parking-payment system referenced by MUTCD parking signs?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not specify any minimum iOS or Android version (or any other software/device requirement) for mobile parking-payment systems. The evidence provided contains no such provision, so this question cannot be answered from the MUTCD. The closest relevant provision is an Option permitting a Mobile Parking Payment (R7-21aP) plaque where payments can be made electronically, such as by telephone or mobile application — but it says nothing about operating-system versions. Options (permitted): - "Where payments can be made electronically, such as by telephone or mobile application, the Mobile Parking Payment (R7-21aP) plaque (see Drawing B in Figure 2B-25) may be installed below or as part of the legend of a Metered Parking sign." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 2B-25 shows the R7-21aP "PARKING PAYMENTS" plaque with a website and phone number example, but no mobile operating-system requirements. [Image 5] Page 167 contains the Option text for the R7-21aP plaque and likewise contains no software version requirements. Citations: - Section 2B.53 Option §13 (p.126) - Figure 2B-25 (p.124) - Page 167
gold_answer: The MUTCD does not specify this information. A correct response should state that the requested value or requirement cannot be determined from the manual rather than inventing an answer.
